test_cases.title: Build and boot real candidate container images
preconditions: Dedicated approved Docker daemon/runner with no shared applications.
Owner-approved private routing and exact artifact provenance.
steps: Build images from exact candidate SHA.
Create only QA-owned project/network/volume and perform the named check.
Capture responses, SQL/health status and artifact digests; remove only owned resources.
expected_results: Named runtime invariant holds with reproducible evidence; no unrelated service or proxy modified.
test_cases.reason: Local Docker socket denied; no permission/daemon changes authorized or attempted. HTTPS additionally B1/B2 blocked.
